objects.name: Analytic 2138
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process making direct ioctl or mmap syscalls against Industrial Control System (ICS) hardware device files, bypassing the vendor's documented Application Programming Interface (API) layer, from a process not in the recognized ICS application list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
